name: Cybercrimes Act 19 of 2020
description: Promulgated December 1, 2021. Consolidates cybercrime offenses (unlawful access, data interference, cyber-fraud/extortion/forgery), imposes reporting duties on electronic communications service providers and financial institutions.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Government of South Africa (gov.za) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Government of South Africa (gov.za).
